name: p5.tree
description: Shader development and space transformations WEBGL addon library.

scripts.build: npm run build:tree && npm run build:ui && rollup -c
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.reset: rm -rf node_modules dist deps/*/dist package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.publish:tree: npm run build:tree && npm publish -w @nakednous/tree --access public
scripts.publish:ui: npm run build:ui && npm publish -w @nakednous/ui --access public

author: Jean Pierre Charalambos <nakednous@gmail.com>
